captures.text: My dog is named Moki. Moki fell in a puddle.
My story is called Pip and the Pillow Planet. Pip is a pretend rabbit who lands on a pillow planet.
Mình thích xếp mô hình bằng giấy.
Mèo nhà mình tên là Bông. Bông làm đổ chậu cây.

queries.text: Do you remember the pet tumble involving water that I told you about?
Recall what I said about sketching tiny spacecraft.
Nhắc lại điều mình kể về việc làm đồ chơi bằng giấy.
Bạn còn nhớ chuyện con chó ngã vào nước mình đã kể không?
Recall the plant-container mishap I told you about.
Can you recall the make-believe rabbit’s landing place I told you about?

validationQueries.text: Nhớ lại chuyện vẽ tàu vũ trụ nhỏ mình từng kể.
Recall the paper folding pastime I shared.
Do you remember Bông breaking the flower pot I told you about?
Do you recall my dog swimming across a lake?
Do you remember my dog getting a bath after the puddle?
Do you recall a real rabbit landing on a pillow planet at my home?

typedQueries.ambiguous: Do you remember my pet's name?

limitations: Tiny calibrated integration benchmark plus six new dialogue queries; no broad held-out or 95% retrieval-quality claim.
The six added exact question texts were fixed before new requests and were not inputs to either embedding calibration batch.
Automated negative-word scans catch bounded explicit assertions only; independent review must assess paraphrases, presuppositions and qualified claims.
Typed synthetic EN/VI inputs, age 6-8, friend/ENFP. Receipts are simulated; no physical voice, TTS or browser.
PGlite pgvector only. No native PostgreSQL or production session/connection.
The 365-day step is a controlled clock advance, not a year-long operational soak.
Stale-worker control evicts one derived vector only, then uses a genuine embedding of the old approved projection.
Model replies and source-grounding semantics need separate review; scores and engine approval alone are insufficient.
